name: Find Shared Folder Email
description: Search for an email in a shared folder in Microsoft Outlook. [See the documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/user-list-messages)

configurable_props.name: userId
configurable_props.label: User ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the user to get messages for

configurable_props.name: sharedFolderId
configurable_props.label: Shared Folder ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the shared folder to get messages for

configurable_props.name: info
configurable_props.content: **Note:** `$search` cannot be used together with `$filter` or `$orderby`. When you specify `$filter`, the service infers a sort order for the results. If you use both `$orderby` and `$filter` to get messages, because the server always infers a sort order for the results of a `$filter`, you must [specify properties in certain ways](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/user-list-messages#using-filter-and-orderby-in-the-same-query).

configurable_props.name: search
configurable_props.label: Search
configurable_props.description: Search for an email in Microsoft Outlook. Can search for specific message properties such as `"to:example@example.com"` or `"subject:example"`. If the property is excluded, the search targets the default propertes `from`, `subject`, and `body`. For example, `"pizza"` will search for messages with the word `pizza` in the subject, body, or from address, but `"to:example@example.com"` will only search for messages to `example@example.com`. Not for use with `$filter` or `$orderby`.

configurable_props.name: filter
configurable_props.label: Filter
configurable_props.description: Filters results. For example, `contains(subject, 'meet for lunch?')` will include messages whose subject contains ‘meet for lunch?’. [See documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/filter-query-parameter) for the full list of operations. Not for use with `$search`.

configurable_props.name: orderBy
configurable_props.label: Order By
configurable_props.description: Order results by a property. For example, `receivedDateTime desc` will order messages by the received date in descending order. Not for use with `$search`.

configurable_props.name: maxResults
configurable_props.label: Max Results
configurable_props.description: The maximum number of results to return
